messages.content:
You are FOXO's lifestyle coach. Using the doctor's review of a member's lab results, write a practical diet and lifestyle plan for a member living in India.

Rules:
1. Respect the member's diet, allergies and conditions in every item:
   - vegetarian: no meat, fish, seafood or eggs
   - eggetarian: eggs are fine; no meat, fish or seafood
   - vegan: no animal products, including dairy, ghee and honey
   - jain: vegetarian with no eggs, no honey, no onion or garlic, and no root vegetables (potato, carrot, beetroot, radish, ginger and similar)
   - allergies: never include the allergen in any form
   - diabetes: no sugar, jaggery, honey, sweets or sweetened drinks
2. Each diet recommendation must target one of the abnormal biomarkers in the doctor's findings. Put that biomarker's name in linked_biomarker, written as in the findings.
3. Never contradict the doctor's lifestyle_restrictions. If the doctor restricts exercise, suggest only gentle activity such as an easy walk, and tell the member to follow the doctor's advice.
4. Do not recommend medicines or supplements and never give doses. If a supplement might help, say "ask your FOXO doctor".
5. Use everyday Indian foods (dal, millets, seasonal sabzi, sprouts and so on) and be specific about portions and timing.
6. Put foods to eat in diet_recommendations and foods to limit or avoid in foods_to_avoid.
7. retest_in_weeks is usually 12.

Respond with a single JSON object that matches this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"DietRecommendation": {"properties": {"item": {"title": "Item", "type": "string"}, "rationale": {"title": "Rationale", "type": "string"}, "linked_biomarker": {"title": "Linked Biomarker", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["item", "rationale", "linked_biomarker"], "title": "DietRecommendation", "type": "object"}}, "properties": {"focus_areas": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Focus Areas", "type": "array"}, "diet_recommendations": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/DietRecommendation"}, "title": "Diet Recommendations", "type": "array"}, "foods_to_avoid": {"default": [], "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Foods To Avoid", "type": "array"}, "activity": {"title": "Activity", "type": "string"}, "sleep": {"title": "Sleep", "type": "string"}, "retest_in_weeks": {"title": "Retest In Weeks", "type": "integer"}}, "required": ["focus_areas", "diet_recommendations", "activity", "sleep", "retest_in_weeks"], "title": "CoachPlan", "type": "object"}

response: {"focus_areas":["Lower high triglycerides with a high-fibre, low-refined-carb Jain diet","Address low vitamin D with fortified foods and safe sun exposure; ask your FOXO doctor about supplements","Build sustainable activity and sleep habits"],"diet_recommendations":[{"item":"At lunch and dinner, start with 1 katori (about 150 ml) of moong or masoor dal soup or dal, and replace refined-flour rotis with 1–2 bajra/jowar/ragi rotis.","rationale":"Dal and millet fibre help lower triglycerides by replacing refined carbohydrates and improving satiety.","linked_biomarker":"triglycerides"},{"item":"Use whole millets for 2 meals daily: 1 cup cooked foxtail millet khichdi/upma or 1–2 millet rotis per meal; keep total cooked grain to about 1 cup per meal.","rationale":"Whole millets have more fibre than refined grains and help reduce triglyceride-rich very-low-density lipoprotein production.","linked_biomarker":"triglycerides"},{"item":"Fill half the plate at lunch and dinner with 1–2 katoris of seasonal non-root vegetables such as lauki, tinda, parwal, bhindi, beans, spinach or methi, cooked with 1 tsp oil.","rationale":"Non-starchy vegetables add fibre and volume with few calories, supporting triglyceride control and weight management.","linked_biomarker":"triglycerides"},{"item":"Include one Jain-friendly protein at each meal: 1 katori dal, 1 katori curd, 30–40 g paneer, or 1 katori sprouted moong/moth beans.","rationale":"Protein and fibre at meals improve fullness and reduce intake of refined carbohydrates that raise triglycerides.","linked_biomarker":"triglycerides"},{"item":"For snacks, eat 1 small handful (about 20 g) of unsalted almonds/walnuts/pumpkin seeds or 1 tbsp flaxseed powder; choose unsweetened, honey-free versions.","rationale":"Unsaturated fats and flax fibre can support lipid improvement when used in place of fried or sweet snacks.","linked_biomarker":"triglycerides"},{"item":"If you take dairy, have 1 cup fortified milk or 1 katori fortified curd daily with a meal; check the label for vitamin D fortification.","rationale":"Fortified dairy is a practical food source of vitamin D in a Jain vegetarian diet; ask your FOXO doctor whether a supplement is needed.","linked_biomarker":"vitamin_d"}],"foods_to_avoid":["Sugar, jaggery, honey, sweets, mithai, sweetened drinks, fruit juices, and sugar-coated cereals","Deep-fried snacks such as samosa, pakora, puri and bhajji; keep these rare","Refined-flour foods such as maida bread, naan, bhatura, cakes, biscuits and white pasta","Large amounts of ghee, butter, cream and coconut oil; use small measured amounts","Sweetened curd, lassi, milkshakes and packaged beverages","For Jain diet: avoid onion, garlic, honey and root vegetables such as potato, carrot, beetroot, radish and ginger"],"activity":"No exercise restrictions were noted by your doctor. Aim for 20–30 minutes of brisk walking 5 days a week, plus 15–20 minutes of safe morning sunlight on arms/face 3–4 times a week. If any discomfort occurs, stop and follow your doctor’s advice.","sleep":"7–8 hours per night; keep regular sleep and wake times and avoid screens for 30 minutes before bed.","retest_in_weeks":12}
